# Vendored browser libraries

Committed as-is, so the admin page works without npm, a build step or a CDN.

| File | Library | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `centrifuge.js` | [centrifuge-js](https://github.com/centrifugal/centrifuge-js) | 5.8.0 | <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/centrifuge@5.8.0/dist/centrifuge.js> | MIT |

To update: download the new `dist/centrifuge.js`, replace the file, update the version above.
